A football team builder app designed for simplicity.
 
Need a quick and easy way to show your friends your ideal football team line-up or you just want to imagine a dream football team? Then look no further.
 
Feature's of this football team builder:

• Drag and drop an individual player anywhere on the pitch
• Pick football players from a filtered list that also shows the player's photo
• Create your own kits
• Change kit colors
• Choose pitch design
• Change player size
• Save your football teams to and edit them on demand
